answer: Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the inlet audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, as the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the beacon band is published for each class. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 182 to 297 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the kernel identity is graded at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
